notes.title: Dark Roll: Free Kick Challenge Release Date
notes.notes:
Dark Roll: Free Kick Challenge will be available next thursday, that is on
[h3][b]5th of august 2021[/b][/h3]
at around 10:00 AM PDT / 05:00 PM GMT.

If it's your first time to hear about this project, feel no shame! Just wishlist the game and learn more here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1290260/Dark_Roll_Free_Kick_Challenge/

The game will be entirely [b]FREE TO PLAY,[/b] with an optional Premium Supporter Pack to buy and support the development of the game, as well as any future projects I'll work on. You can read up on what you get for buying Premium Supporter Pack here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1329100/Dark_Roll_Free_Kick_Challenge__Premium_Supporter_Pack/

If you haven't seen the trailer yet, now is your chance to get hyped up for those challenging 1 on 1 online pvp matches and many difficult single player challenges:

[previewyoutube=OwBfnaD4E7w;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Endless Roll Release Date
notes.notes:
Endless Roll and Baby Mode will be released together in an update on the last friday of the month, on [b]28.02.2020[/b], around early evening in the European time zone. This means the update should be available around the noon in America and late night in Australia / Asia.

If you've missed the news, you can read up on Endless Roll here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791463410857/announcements/detail/1693848448225676328]Endless Roll Announcement[/url]

And here you can find more information regarding Baby Mode:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791463410857/announcements/detail/1693848448252105998]Baby Mode Announcement[/url]

The wait is almost over.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 and the future of Dark Roll
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.2 is here:
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Cloud support.[/b]
Your progress is now saved on Steam servers. If you want to play Dark Roll on another computer, your previous progress will be downloaded from the server. Just keep in mind that you have to run the game at least once after this update for your saves to be uploaded to Steam servers.
[/list]

I also have a question for you. Yes, you!

I do plan to release more content in future. I don't want to spill too much right now... But what I'm planning on is expanding the game in [b]new[/b], [b]various[/b], [b]fun[/b] and [b]exciting[/b] ways. And a thought went through my head - should new content be accompanied by new Steam achievements?

You may wonder "Why would this be any kind of a problem for anyone?". See, some people on here are true achievement hunters. And once you get 100% achievements in a game, it may seem unfair for new achievements to be released.

[b]I want to know your opinion so I made this anonymous questionnaire. Please spare 5 seconds of your precious time to answer, I'll appreciate it!

https://forms.gle/BQLBL3tViWP1qjKM7[/b]

If you want to report a bug, please e-mail:
artbariangames@gmail.com

Please like my Facebook page if you haven't yet. You don't want to miss any important updates in future, do you?
www.fb.com/artbariangames

[b]Also, leave a review on Steam if you didn't yet.[/b] Your opinion truly matters, and I'd like to know what was done right and what could have been done differently.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
A patch fixing few minor issues has been released:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where while the game was paused, player could press jump couple of times to jump really high after unpausing the game.
[*] While paused, pressing escape is now unpausing the game. Previously it would quit game / quit to lobby.
[*] When entering The Lobby for the first time a window pops up with few key informations that weren't previously mentioned anywhere.
[/list]

If you haven't reviewed my game yet, please do so. What people think matters a lot to me. It will help me to continue improving myself and make even better games in future!

To keep up to date with Dark Roll and my future projects please like my facebook page: www.facebook.com/ArtbarianGames/

If you found any bugs or issues with the game please contact me by sending an e-mail to: artbariangames@gmail.com
